thread:
Priya: Heads-up: pilot for the new rate sheet goes live Mon 2027-06-14. Need final approvals + PO mapping for enterprise customers.
Noah: Which cohorts are in the pilot? small commercial + 1 enterprise account?
Priya: Pilot = 5k PLG users (50/50 A/B) + 1 named enterprise (AcmeCorp) for end-to-end billing check.
Jules: For AcmeCorp we need a vendor contract amendment and a PO number before we apply price override. Karin - can legal confirm timeline?
Karin: Legal can turn the amendment in 48 hours if procurement provides PO + contact.
Priya: Good. Finance: do we do invoice-preview emails for AcmeCorp? We want a non-bill dry run.
Noah: Yes — Stripe supports upcoming_invoice preview via API. We'll add `billing_experiment_preview=true` metadata for those customers.
Jules: Also add an invoice line item code `ratepilot-adjust` so revenue reports can filter.
Priya: Agreed. Two experiment variants: A = current rates (control), B = new block pricing with per-1k token buckets.
Priya: B details: base monthly + per-1k token block at $0.60/block, embedding calls billed at +5%.
Noah: Ops note: feature flag = `ratepilot.v1` and rollout tag `rp-20270614`. Please ensure our monitoring captures `billing.delta_usd` and `invoice.previewed` metrics.
Karin: Accounting question: how do we show credits for customers on annual contracts? We shouldn't auto-credit without sales approval.
Jules: For annuals: Sales will own credits. We'll surface a proposed credit amount in the preview and require manual approval before applying any adjustments.
Priya: Can we run a 200-account dry-run (mix of PLG + 1 enterprise) Tue morning? Need CSV of invoice previews by 9am.
Noah: I'll script the preview. SQL extract for candidate list I'll use:
```
SELECT id as customer_id, tier, last_30d_tokens as tokens
FROM customers
WHERE active=true AND trial=false
ORDER BY last_30d_tokens DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Noah: Script will call Stripe upcoming_invoice API and attach `ratepilot-experiment` metadata. No charges.
Jules: Reconciliation threshold = revenue delta < 1.5% for the sample otherwise hold.
Priya: Good. Also check tax calc changes; country-level tax rates could shift totals.
Karin: Legal also flagged vendor pass-through fees for certain regions. Add a `vendor_fee` line item when applicable.
Noah: Ops: recommend canary ramp 200 -> 2k -> full 5k over 48 hours with health checks at each step (invoices preview count, error rate <0.1%, previewed_to_manual_approval ratio).
deploy-bot: scheduled rollout created: `ratepilot/2027-06-14` (canary=200 -> 2000 -> 5000).
Priya: Owners: Noah = preview script + infra flags. Jules = reporting & invoice line tagging. Karin = legal PO/contract. Me = final sign-off + comms. React :white_check_mark: when you have tasks.
Noah: :white_check_mark:
Jules: :white_check_mark:
Karin: :white_check_mark:
finance-bot: Reminder: upload PO docs to /shared/finance/purchase_orders and tag thread.
Priya: Thanks all — will post the pilot sheet (v3) and the sample CSV once generated.
Noah: I'll drop the preview CSV to #finance-reports by Tue 09:00.
Priya: Final note: if invoice preview mismatches >1.5% or taxes differ unexpectedly we pause and escalate to sales + legal.
